paragraphs.source_en: Something cracked in the flames. The fire died down for a moment and wreaths of black smoke rolled from under the roof. There was another terrible crash and something huge collapsed.

units.source_en: The fire died down for a moment and wreaths of black smoke rolled from under the roof.
There was another terrible crash and something huge collapsed.

paragraphs.source_en: “Ou-rou-rou!” yelled the crowd, echoing the crash of the collapsing roof of the barn, the burning grain in which diffused a cakelike aroma all around. The flames flared up again, lighting the animated, delighted, exhausted faces of the spectators.

paragraphs.source_en: The man in the frieze coat raised his arms and shouted:

units.source_en: The man in the frieze coat raised his arms and shouted:

paragraphs.source_en: “It’s fine, lads! Now it’s raging... It’s fine!”
“That’s the owner himself,” cried several voices.

units.source_en: “That’s the owner himself,” cried several voices.

paragraphs.source_en: “Well then,” continued Prince Andrew to Alpátych, “report to them as I have told you”; and not replying a word to Berg who was now mute beside him, he touched his horse and rode down the side street.
